verdict.rationale: Fastmail is a hosted email service. Self-hosting is still a fair question for an email product, so the axis applies. No evidence shows Fastmail offering a self-hostable app or letting users run their own mail pipeline. JMAP being an open standard with third-party server implementations is a protocol building block, not a Fastmail self-host capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
